verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms the documented install path runs fully non-interactively (`-y`, `--copy`, agent and skill selected by flag), so it can be scripted in CI. The triage skill also labels issues `ready-for-agent` for an AFK agent, which points to unattended agent use. However, the skills themselves are built around interactive user confirmation (grilling, confirming test seams), and nothing documents running them headlessly or in a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI execution of the skills, non-interactive modes for skills that require user confirmation, CI examples or independent corroboration of automated runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: the documented skills.sh install path works non-interactively, exactly as the README promises
`ready-for-agent`: fully specified, ready for an AFK agent
